_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_m" REAL NULL, "location_name" TEXT NULL, "location_region" TEXT NULL, "privacy_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "moon_phase" TEXT NOT NULL, "moon_illumination" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_retroactive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_retroactive" IN (0, 1)), "venue_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather_snapshots" ("trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NULL, "temperature_c" REAL NULL, "pressure_hpa" REAL NULL, "pressure_trend3h_hpa" REAL NULL, "wind_speed_kmh" REAL NULL, "wind_direction_deg" REAL NULL, "precipitation_mm" REAL NULL, "humidity_pct" REAL NULL, "hourly_json" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("trip_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scientific_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "habitats" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "region_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species_names" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "species_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "region" TEXT NULL, "needs_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_review" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "baits" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gear" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catches" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id), "species_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "caught_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NULL, "length_mm" INTEGER NULL, "released" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("released" IN (0, 1)), "bait_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES baits (id), "gear_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES gear (id), "depth_mm" INTEGER NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catch_photos" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "catch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catches (id), "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "subject_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_maps" ("area_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "center_latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "center_longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "half_size_meters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("area_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "venue_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
